adminSubclasses.name: Full Path of the Ancestral Guardian
adminSubclasses.summary: A protector whose rage calls ancestral spirits to mark enemies and shield allies. This is the larger experimental implementation kept behind admin mode for testing.
gameplayGuide: This path is strongest when you stand near allies and make yourself the problem enemies must answer.
While raging, your first empowered hit can mark a foe with ancestral pressure, making them less effective against your friends.
Spirit Shield and Vengeful Ancestors appear as reaction defenses, reducing damage to allies and later punishing the attacker.

adminSubclasses.summary: A brutal close-quarters rager who turns armor, momentum, and reckless pressure into damage. This is the larger experimental implementation kept behind admin mode for testing.
gameplayGuide: Battlerager wants to be in melee during Rage, pressing into enemies instead of holding back.
Battlerager Spikes gives you a bonus-action attack while raging, and Reckless Abandon rewards Reckless Attack with temporary HP.
Later features add charging mobility and automatic spike punishment when enemies hit you in melee.

adminSubclasses.name: Full Path of the Beast
adminSubclasses.summary: A shapeshifting predator whose rage manifests fangs, claws, tail, mobility, and infectious fury. This is the larger experimental implementation kept behind admin mode for testing.
gameplayGuide: This path treats Rage as a partial transformation. When you enter Rage, choose Bite, Claws, or Tail for the whole rage.
Bite favors staying alive, Claws favor extra offense, and Tail favors defensive reach. The form does not cost another bonus action after Rage.
Higher levels add supernatural movement, infectious fury on weapon hits, and a pack-hunt rally for nearby allies.

subclasses.name: Life Domain

gameplayGuide: Use Preserve Life when several heroes are hurt or one ally is close to falling.
Life Domain is about reliable recovery, stronger healing spells, and steady party survival.

subclasses.name: Tempest Domain

Elemental Shape adds a short burst of resistance and damage when your form needs more pressure.

subclasses.summary: A terrain-bound caster who recovers magic and turns ground control into advantage.

subclasses.name: Champion
subclasses.summary: A simple, reliable weapon specialist with stronger critical hits, athletic grit, and late-game survival.
gameplayGuide: Choose Champion when you want a fighter that is powerful without juggling many buttons.
Most of your strength is always on: better critical hits, stronger physical talent, and the ability to recover when badly hurt.

features.description: Your weapon attacks land critical hits more often, starting on a 19 or 20.

Later levels add more known shot options, improve your magic archery, and eventually restore one shot at the start of combat if you are empty.

features.name: Ever-Ready Shot

subclasses.name: The Fiend
subclasses.summary: A destructive patron path that feeds on kills, fire, and infernal resilience.
gameplayGuide: Fiend warlocks lean on infernal luck and burst damage.
Use Hurl Through Hell when one target needs to disappear under a huge infernal burst.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.description: Feed on victory, gaining temporary HP after a kill or as an infernal combat burst.

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.description: Add infernal luck to an important roll.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.description: Briefly resist common dungeon damage with infernal toughness.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.description: Banish a foe through nightmare fire for heavy damage.

features.name: Infernal Patronage
features.description: Recover pact power and ready hellfire when your patron pushes you onward.

abilities.name: Dark One's Blessing
abilities.description: Draw infernal vigor from violence. Gain temporary HP for the next exchange.

abilities.name: Dark One's Own Luck
abilities.description: Call on infernal luck. Your next attack or save gains a strong bonus.

abilities.name: Fiendish Resilience
abilities.description: Harden yourself with fiendish resilience, resisting fire and poison briefly.

abilities.name: Hurl Through Hell
abilities.description: Hurl a visible enemy through infernal torment, dealing psychic and fire damage and briefly banishing it.

abilities.name: Infernal Patronage
abilities.description: Your patron pours power back into you. Recover pact spell points and ready hellfire.

subclasses.name: The Hexblade
subclasses.summary: A cursed weapon warlock who marks prey and calls a specter ally.
gameplayGuide: Hexblade plays like a curse duelist. Curse the target you want dead, then attack or blast it down.
Hexblade weapon attacks use Charisma for hit and damage in this game, so CHA stays your main combat stat.
Accursed Specter calls a short-lived spirit that fights beside you after you claim a soul.

features.name: Hexblade's Curse
features.description: Mark a foe so your hits against it are stronger.

features.name: Accursed Specter
features.description: Call a short-duration specter ally.

features.name: Armor of Hexes
features.description: When your curse is active, wrap yourself in defensive shadow.

features.name: Master of Hexes
features.description: Move your curse's pressure into another strike when a target falls.

features.name: Cursed Sovereign
features.description: Empower your curse against multiple enemies or one doomed target.

abilities.name: Hexblade's Curse
abilities.description: Curse your prey. Your next weapon hit or blast deals extra necrotic damage and marks it.

abilities.name: Accursed Specter
abilities.description: Call a short-lived specter that keeps its distance and harrys enemies.

abilities.name: Armor of Hexes
abilities.description: Let cursed shadow bend a strike away from you, raising your AC briefly.

abilities.name: Master of Hexes
abilities.description: Carry your curse onward. Your next hit deals necrotic damage and marks the new target.

abilities.name: Cursed Sovereign
abilities.description: Unleash your curse in a burst, damaging and marking nearby enemies.

subclasses.name: The Great Old One
subclasses.summary: An alien mind patron that turns psychic pressure into fear, confusion, and brief domination.
gameplayGuide: Great Old One controls the fight. Use psychic marks to weaken targets before they hurt the party.
Alien Thrall briefly turns a creature against its allies. Powerful foes resist full control but still suffer mental disruption.

features.name: Psychic Intrusion
features.description: Press alien thoughts into a target, dealing psychic damage and shaking its attacks.

features.name: Entropic Ward
features.description: Twist probability to protect yourself and set up your next strike.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.description: Resist psychic pressure and punish minds that strike yours.

features.name: Alien Thrall
features.description: Briefly dominate an enemy or weaken a boss-safe target.

features.name: Elder Revelation
features.description: Unleash a psychic burst that frightens the room.

subclasses.summary: A death mage who drains life and fights beside a simple undead ally.
gameplayGuide: Necromancy rewards finishing enemies with spells and spending actions to call an undead helper.
The undead fights on its own beside the party. If the space is too crowded, its power becomes an immediate skeletal strike instead.

gameplayGuide: Divination is about control and foresight. Use Portent before a key attack or save.
